title: Design a News Feed
description: Design a follower-based home news feed for text posts and external media references, balancing high-degree authors, freshness, privacy and stable pagination.
functionalRequirements: Publish posts and follow or unfollow authors
Read a paginated home feed of eligible followed-author posts
Apply deletion, blocks and privacy changes to served results
Support a justified chronological or lightweight ranked feed
nonFunctionalRequirements: Feed server p95 below 300 ms within a region
Normal-author posts should appear within 5 seconds under healthy load, with explicit degradation for backlogs
constraints: 20 million DAU, 2 million posts/day and 200 million feed page reads/day; assume 5x peaks
A page returns 20 post references; ordinary authors average 100 eligible followers
A few authors have more than 1 million followers and must not be treated as ordinary fanout keys
outOfScope: Media upload, transcoding and storage internals
Search, advertising auctions and exact company-specific traffic

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.

stateEstimates.name: 500 logical feed references per active recipient

notes: The 100-follower fanout estimate applies to ordinary authors, not to the million-follower tail.
Each page has 20 references: 200 million page reads imply up to 4 billion metadata hydrations/day before batching/cache reuse.
Feed-reference sizing excludes list/index overhead and post bodies; external media bytes and model-training data are outside scope.
